mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of the instances when FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.5% within the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a weakening labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and business investment are expected to decline.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of the instances when UNRATE rises by more than 0.5% within the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real estate activity (HOUST) by more than 10% over the last 3 months signals a weakening demand in the housing market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as it reflects broader economic weakness.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of the instances when HOUST declines by more than 10% over the last 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% within the last month signals a strengthening supply side of the economy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as it reflects increased economic activity and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 40% of the instances when INDPRO increases by more than 2% within the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 5% over the last 3 months signals a strengthening consumer demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as it reflects increased consumer spending and economic growth.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances when RSAFS increases by more than 5% over the last 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) both by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a strengthening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as it reflects increased economic activity and consumer confidence.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 0.5% and UNRATE decreases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances when both PAYEMS and UNRATE meet the trigger conditions.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment (CPIAUCSL) below 2% for the last 3 months signals a stable monetary policy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as it reflects controlled inflation and potential for accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of the instances when CPIAUCSL remains below 2% for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a high level of real GDP (GDPC1) relative to its 12-month moving average suggests strong economic fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of the instances when GDPC1 is above its 12-month moving average.
